item.title: Fix worktree cleanup: fail on cd instead of silent swallow
item.intent: When returning to PROJECT_ROOT after a worktree failure, a failed cd must abort the sprint loop — silently continuing in the wrong directory corrupts subsequent backlog operations.
steps: Replace || true with || { log_error 'Cannot return to project root'; break; }
Check for other instances of cd ... || true that should also fail loudly

acceptanceCriteria.text: cd failure to PROJECT_ROOT breaks the sprint loop instead of continuing
